item.description:
The Secret behind Ching’s Secret!

Chings Soy sauce has more sugar, salt and color than soybeans in it!

But why does a soy sauce even need colour and sugar?

If soy isn’t the main ingredient in soy sauce, what are we exactly paying for?

In this video, I’ve shared a better alternative to Ching’s Soy Sauce.

This video is not sponsored. I don’t do paid junk food promotions at all. In fact, I also don’t do paid clean food brands to stay completely unbiased.

Note: The line “Longer the ingredient list, longer the medication list” is a simplified line. It is not always true and there are many exceptions. But usually, better packaged foods contain fewer ingredients.

#FoodPharmer #LabelPadhegaIndia

item.title: ▶ Bisleri is not mineral water!...
item.dc:creator: Food Pharmer · Instagram
item.description:
Bisleri is not mineral water!

In fact, Kinley, Aquafina, Rail Neer… none of these are mineral water. They are all packaged drinking water.

Examples of real mineral water: Vedica, Evian, Voss, Himalayan, Aava.

So what’s the actual difference?

Packaged Drinking Water:
• Can come from sources like borewells, groundwater or municipal supplies.
• Is treated using processes like RO, UV or ozonisation.
• Minerals may be added back during processing.

Natural Mineral Water:
• Comes from natural springs or underground aquifers.
• Gets its minerals naturally from its source.
• Has a naturally occurring mineral composition.

When I started the Label Padhega India movement, the focus was on the food industry. But I’m happy to see that the movement is now expanding beyond food.

Now we will also read the label for water.

Label Padhega India, Swasth Banega India!

item.title: ▶ #collab...
item.dc:creator: Food Pharmer · Instagram
item.description:
#collab

3 BIG SCAMS PEOPLE SHOULD BE CAREFUL OF

When people buy a product, they check:

1. Specifications
2. Compare prices
3. Ratings

But how many of us check what happens after the purchase?
Can we easily reach customer care? Is getting support a hassle? Are there terms and conditions we should know about?

These things might seem unimportant when everything is going well, but they matter when something goes wrong.

Scams exist not just in food but in almost every industry, and most people realise them only after the damage starts and the money is already gone!

While investigating and researching warranties, we came across CenturyPly and its Total Cover warranty, which offers digital warranty registration and a dedicated claims portal to make the process more accessible. 

In such cases, awareness becomes protection.

A big thanks to @centuryply for being the knowledge partner of this video.

Because buying smart isn’t just about choosing the right product. It’s also about knowing what support you can expect after you buy it.

Ab sirf labels hi nahi, terms & conditions aur warranty bhi samjhega India!

item.title: Thank you @time for this incredible honour!...
item.dc:creator: Food Pharmer · Instagram
item.description:
Thank you @time for this incredible honour!

I feel incredibly lucky, humbled and grateful to be included in the inaugural TIME100 Next India list.

It’s been over 1,000 days since I became Food Pharmer. And I still can’t believe any of this is real.

Every single day, I feel like I’m living in a dream.

Sometimes I genuinely feel like one day I’ll wake up and find myself back in the US, working at McKinsey, and realise that this entire Food Pharmer journey was just one big dream.

We often see actors, athletes, entrepreneurs and business leaders being celebrated on such platforms. And rightly so.

What makes this recognition even more special to me is that a food safety advocate is being featured on a list like TIME100 Next India.

I’m incredibly grateful to every single person who has supported me. But we’re just getting started.

The dream isn’t to make it to a TIME100 list.

The dream is to make 140 crore Indians health literate.

The dream is to make health a subject in every school in India.

And until that dream becomes a reality, we’ll keep fighting.
Thank you for making this dream feel real. ❤️

Love,
Food Pharmer
